method: Unchanged original classes run in Chromium with actual bundled THREE. Tree constructor/setup and Collision2DSystem.update including quad rebuild run directly. Each collision case uses a fresh system with bounds set before static registration, like local startup. Records only shot handlers receiving trees; source handlers for dynamic/dynamic contacts are intentionally not measured. Limit frames call Collision2DSystem before actual LodSystem.update on their shared Rectangle, with resize rebuilding the limit. Removal cases call actual SnowballSystem.update/remove/setup methods with Object3D actor fixtures; actor update reports expiry, effect/collision callbacks record calls, no asset loading/physics/pooling is certified.
